final_truth: The Brandenburg Concertos, composed by Johann Sebastian Bach for Duke Johann von Brandenburg, are six masterworks for instrumental ensemble. Written in 1725, they remain pinnacles of Baroque composition, showcasing Bach’s genius in counterpoint, orchestration, and expressive depth. These works were composed to demonstrate the full potential of the newly developed orchestra and remain a cornerstone of the choral/concert repertoire.
